turns.user_utterance: Hey, I'm standing at the checkout and my card just got rejected—this is ridiculous!
turns.assistant_response: Sorry about that—when you say the card was rejected at the checkout, do you mean the payment was simply declined, or did the terminal show something like “card not recognized”/“try another card”? Also, are you paying in-store with the chip/contactless, or online?

turns.user_utterance: It just said “declined” and I was using contactless at the store.
turns.assistant_response: Got it—if the terminal says “declined” while you’re paying contactless, it usually means the card payment was rejected. Which is it: did you try again using chip-and-PIN, or only contactless? And is this payment the first attempt today for this merchant amount?
